measurand: BDI - belief displacement index for proposition UK-EU-350M-2016

proposition.text: The UK sends GBP 350 million per week to the European Union.
proposition.basis: GBP 350m is a gross figure before the UK rebate. For 2016/17 HM Treasury reports gross GBP 16.9bn (~GBP 325m/week), GBP 12.2bn after the GBP 4.8bn rebate (~GBP 235m/week), and GBP 8.1bn net of public-sector receipts (~GBP 156m/week). The UK Statistics Authority statement of 27 May 2016 established that gross-for-net use was misleading; it issued no net estimate of its own.
proposition.shortfall_note: UK Statistics Authority and HM Treasury are not fully independent: the Authority comments on Treasury and ONS figures. The KCL/Ipsos MORI survey is the instrument, not a source for V(F), and is registered as such.

population: GB adults aged 18-75 reporting awareness of the proposition, October 2018

anchor.base_n_note: Derived as 2200 x 0.67 from published percentages; no claim-aware base is published directly.

budget.note: Not the numeric range on the net contribution

budget.source: Residual claim reuse after the campaign

capability.interpretation: Capability statements characterise the procedure. They are not a decision against a zero-prevalence null, which is not physically realisable.

decision.reason: The null of zero prevalence for a verified-false proposition cannot be prepared, so u_0 cannot be measured. Substantive claims rest on differences, where a null of no change is attainable.

wave_2016.source: Ipsos MORI Political Monitor, June 2016 topline, Q19/Q20

wave_2018.source: Policy Institute at KCL / Ipsos MORI / UK in a Changing Europe

harmonisation.result: Each interval contains the other wave's reading. Neither stability nor change is established.
harmonisation.missing_quantity: Endorsement rate among respondents not previously aware of the claim. Measurable in 2016, where belief was asked of all respondents; not reported for 2018.

not_evaluated: harmonisation term for the awareness filter
mode effect, telephone against online panel
population term for the 18+ against 18-75 difference
endogeneity of the claim-aware population to the campaign itself
